verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll's own docs say approved timesheets sync to QuickBooks, and that Payroll AI collects time and attendance data so you can run payroll. That supports time entries feeding payroll, but the evidence says "syncs to QuickBooks" rather than explicitly showing hours landing on a payroll run, and overtime is never mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that hourly time entries populate paychecks in the payroll run, overtime calculation or flow-through, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
